pk.context: 40 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: Its metabolites are at least eight times less potent than citalopram at blocking serotonin reuptake, so they likely add little.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability is about 80%, and food does not affect absorption. About 80% is bound to plasma proteins, and biotransformation is mainly hepatic.
A hydrobromide salt that is a fine, white to off-white powder. The active moiety has a molecular weight of 324.4.
Under an NDA, tablets of 10, 20 and 40 mg, dosed once daily.
Boxed warning for suicidal thoughts in young patients. Contraindicated with MAOIs within 14 days, with pimozide, and in hypersensitivity; ejaculatory delay in men is the most common reaction.
Treatment of major depressive disorder in adults.
Presumed to inhibit neuronal serotonin reuptake in the CNS, potentiating serotonergic activity.
The generic name begins with C and has ten letters.
